jobs.title: Director, Software Development
jobs.description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.

We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?

We are looking for a Director of Software Development to lead a key area of our Digital Employee Experience (DEX) platform. In this role, you will build and lead a new engineering team in Austin while driving the delivery of a strategic initiative that helps Managed Service Providers (MSPs) monitor, automate, and optimize digital employee experiences across large customer environments.

You will be responsible for defining technical direction, building a high-performing team, and partnering closely with Product, Engineering, and Operations leaders to deliver scalable, reliable solutions that create measurable customer value.

As part of TeamViewer's AI-native engineering transformation, you will also help establish and evolve engineering practices that leverage AI-assisted development while maintaining high standards for quality, security, and reliability.

Responsibilities

Build, hire, and lead a new software engineering team in Austin, establishing a strong engineering culture and operating model.
Own the delivery of a strategic, multi-phase DEX initiative that serves MSP customers at scale.
Define and execute the technical roadmap for your area in alignment with the broader DEX platform strategy.
Drive the full software development lifecycle, ensuring solutions are scalable, reliable, secure, and customer-focused.
Partner with engineering, product, and operational leaders to align priorities and execution across teams.
Establish engineering best practices, development standards, and quality processes that enable teams to move quickly while maintaining strong technical foundations.
Champion the effective adoption of AI-assisted development practices and help shape the organization's evolving AI engineering strategy.
Coach and develop engineering leaders and senior engineers, fostering a culture of accountability, learning, and continuous improvement.

Requirements

Proven experience leading and growing software engineering organizations, including building or scaling teams.
Track record of delivering large-scale SaaS or cloud-based platforms.
Strong technical background with experience in modern distributed systems and cloud-native architectures.
Experience introducing and scaling AI-assisted software development practices within engineering teams.
Ability to balance technical excellence, product priorities, and business outcomes.
Experience setting engineering standards, development practices, and quality expectations across teams.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across engineering, product, and business functions.
Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where team, product, and process are evolving simultaneously.

Preferred Experience

Experience with MSP, endpoint management, IT operations, or digital employee experience platforms.
Familiarity with technologies such as C#, Azure, Kubernetes, Kafka, Databricks, SQL Server, and related cloud-native tooling.
Experience leading teams that use AI coding agents, such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or comparable tools, in production delivery at scale
Working knowledge of model-based failure modes (hallucination, context degradation, prompt injection, non-determinism)

How We Work

We believe AI-assisted development will play an increasingly important role in how software is built and delivered. Engineering leaders at TeamViewer are expected to leverage modern AI development tools while ensuring strong engineering discipline, governance, testing, and quality standards remain at the center of the software delivery process.

You will help shape how these practices evolve across the organization while collaborating with peers to establish consistent and scalable approaches.

What we offer

Competitive compensation and bonuses
Flexible PTO and paid holidays
401(k) with employer matching
Comprehensive Health insurance package including 100% employer-paid medical coverage
Up to 12 weeks of Parental Leave
Basic Life Insurance, Short-Term & Long-Term Disability, 100% employer-paid
Quarterly teambuilding events, leadership luncheons, and companywide “All Hands” meetings
Open door policy and business casual dress code
We celebrate diversity as one of our core values. Join c-a-r-e and lead change initiatives together with us!

Work location for this position is Austin, TX.

TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C-A-R-E and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. We are proud to have an open and embracing workplace environment that will empower you to be your best no matter your gender, civil or family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

If you require any accommodations or adjustments during the application or hiring process, including interview or onboarding support, please reach out to your Talent Acquisition Partner, who will be happy to support you.

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States.

jobs.description:
Job Description

The International Card & Risk Services Technology (ICRST) organization delivers the technology strategy, platforms and solutions that underpin International Card Services and Credit & Fraud Risk across global markets. With approximately 900 colleagues across the UK, US, Canada, India and Mexico, ICRST plays a critical role in shaping enterprise-wide technology outcomes and driving compliance, resilience and innovation.

We are seeking an Engineering Director to lead and grow high-performing, transformational product engineering teams responsible for the architecture, design, engineering, and implementation of reliable, scalable, secure, and impactful technology products and platform applications.

This leader will combine strong technical judgment, hands-on engineering and architecture expertise, people leadership, and strategic thinking to translate business priorities into effective engineering execution. The Engineering Director will partner closely with Product, Design, Architecture, Data, and other business and technology leaders to establish technical direction, modernize applications and platforms, develop engineering talent, improve delivery, and drive innovation across the enterprise.

The successful candidate will be an active technical leader who can operate at both the strategic and hands-on levels—guiding complex architecture and engineering decisions while building an environment of accountability, collaboration, innovation, inclusion, and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

Engineering & Technical Leadership

Lead multiple transformational product engineering teams in the architecture, design, engineering, and implementation of enterprise applications, components, APIs, and platforms.
Provide hands-on technical leadership across complex, cross-functional initiatives, actively participating in solution architecture, platform design, and software product design.
Establish clear engineering priorities aligned with product, technology, and business strategy.
Advance the modernization and transformation of applications and platforms while identifying opportunities to drive innovation across the enterprise.
Partner with senior engineers and architects to define technical strategy, architecture, and modernization priorities.
Guide complex technical decisions involving architecture, technical debt, platform investments, build-versus-buy considerations, scalability, performance, and emerging technologies.
Balance near-term product delivery commitments with long-term platform health, maintainability, scalability, resilience, and technical investment.
Promote pragmatic adoption of new technologies where they can create measurable customer or business value.

Product Delivery & Operational Excellence

Own delivery across a portfolio of engineering initiatives, consistently delivering high-quality software products and capabilities on time and within allocated product budgets.
Partner closely with Product Owners and business and technology stakeholders to establish priorities, plan development schedules, and execute major product increments and releases.
Enable successful delivery of critical end-to-end enterprise initiatives by identifying dependencies and risks early and driving resolution across organizational boundaries.
Ensure teams execute predictably and iteratively while maintaining high technical and engineering standards.
Establish and monitor meaningful engineering metrics related to delivery, quality, reliability, security, performance, and developer effectiveness.
Ensure appropriate engineering practices for software quality, testing, observability, resilience, security, CI/CD, DevOps, automation, and operational excellence.
Champion continuous improvement in development processes, tooling, automation, and engineering practices.
Provide technical leadership in the prevention, diagnosis, and resolution of system outages and complex production issues.

People, Talent & Engineering Culture

Lead, inspire, and enable highly talented and engaged engineering teams, creating an environment of accountability, collaboration, innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement.
Play an active role in advancing a strong product engineering culture focused on technical excellence, creativity, customer value, and high-quality execution.
Attract, recruit, develop, coach, mentor, and retain top engineering talent and engineering leaders.
Establish clear expectations and foster a culture of high performance, inclusion, ownership, and constructive feedback.
Evolve team structures and operating models as the organization, technology portfolio, and business priorities grow and change.

Enterprise Partnership

Partner effectively with Product, Architecture, Design, Data, business units, and other technology organizations to translate business requirements into high-quality production software.
Collaborate across organizational boundaries to prioritize, plan, and execute complex enterprise initiatives involving multiple teams, platforms, and systems.
Build strong relationships with senior business and technology stakeholders and communicate technical strategies, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations clearly.
Drive commitments and accountability across end-to-end teams to ensure successful execution of critical enterprise initiatives.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Master’s degree in a related field is a plus.
8–10+ years of software engineering experience, including architecture, design, engineering, and implementation experience within complex enterprise environments and recent experience leading engineering teams.
Demonstrated recent hands-on experience designing, engineering, and successfully implementing enterprise-grade software products and platforms.
Expert-level solution architecture skills with the ability to evaluate complex architectures, engineering approaches, and technical tradeoffs and resolve complex technical issues creatively and effectively.
Experience building scalable, reliable, secure, performant, and maintainable software systems.
Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into high-quality production software and measurable business outcomes.
Experience developing enterprise-grade APIs and modern distributed and microservices-based architectures.
Hands-on experience with modern software engineering practices and technologies, including CI/CD, DevOps, containers, microservices, cloud-native architectures, observability, security, and automated testing.
Recent engineering experience with relevant technologies such as One App, React, Go, Java, Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, Elastic, and PostgreSQL.
Experience with cloud platforms and complex enterprise cloud environments.
Demonstrated ability to optimize the performance, reliability, and scalability of enterprise software systems and components.
Experience managing complex programs involving multiple engineering teams, systems, platforms, and organizational dependencies.
Excellent communication and executive stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to operate effectively in environments characterized by ambiguity, competing priorities, and significant organizational complexity.
Experience with Salesforce or other enterprise platforms relevant to the organization.
Experience operating large-scale, highly available, and/or regulated technology platforms.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering (Utility-Scale Solar & BESS)
jobs.description:
This role is based in Arlington, VA. On-site presence is required.

About the Company

Join a leading independent power producer at the forefront of renewable energy development. With a growing portfolio of utility-scale solar projects across Virginia, Pennsylvania, West Virginia, and Kentucky, our client develops, constructs, owns, and operates renewable energy assets backed by a 7GW+ global pipeline and over 1GW already commissioned.

The Role

We are hiring a Director of Engineering who will be based at the Arlington, Virginia headquarters. This role leads and manages an engineering team supporting projects involving utility-scale solar facilities, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and related generation tie lines and substations. It oversees engineering design activities, coordination with third-party consultants and contractors, and the delivery of technical support throughout project development, procurement, construction, and commissioning.

The engineering group manages civil and electrical design scopes, conducts design reviews to enhance system performance and reduce costs, and develops standardized, repeatable design solutions for future projects. The Director also provides technical leadership to internal teams including Development, M&A;, Construction, Operations Engineering, Compliance, and Asset Management, while establishing team objectives, workflows, and operating procedures.

Key Responsibilities

Lead a multidisciplinary team of civil and electrical engineers and technical specialists
Continuously improve engineering design management processes
Forecast staffing needs based on active projects and future pipeline, and assign resources to support development and construction activities
Identify long-term resource requirements and recruit project engineering personnel
Act as a senior technical authority supporting development, M&A, and construction efforts, and manage external subject-matter experts as required
Review and resolve complex technical issues in collaboration with internal experts and external consultants
Develop and implement efficient engineering workflows focused on standardization and repeatable designs
Provide technical coordination with Operations Engineering, Development, Compliance, and Asset Management teams at various project stages
Ensure regulatory and compliance requirements, including NERC standards, are incorporated into project designs
Lead technical coordination with lenders' independent engineers during design and construction phases
Periodic site visits as required

Education and Experience

Bachelor's degree in engineering required; electrical engineering preferred
Professional Engineering License
8 years + of experience in the energy industry
Minimum of 5 years of experience in utility-scale solar project engineering; BESS experience is a plus
Experience working in PJM and MISO markets is a plus
Background in civil and electrical design, medium-voltage collection systems, high-voltage substations, and SCADA for utility-scale solar projects
Experience supporting construction and commissioning activities
Experience preparing or reviewing construction cost estimates for similar projects

Work Location, Remote Work, and Travel

This position will be based in Arlington, VA. Travel may be required over time.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

Overview

As Director of Engineering – User Experience, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for Scout Motors' customer facing Digital Products on Web and Mobile. You will lead multiple engineering teams delivering the customer facing web experience for product, brand, and growth areas, and interface with our Sales Engineering team on building an end-to-end checkout process. In addition, this role will lead a mobile engineering team responsible for the Scout mobile vehicle companion that includes the Vehicle controls and interactions along so a Scout customer purchasing experience. You will partner closely with Product, UX, Operations, Sales, Marketing, IT, Vehicle Engineering and external partners to deliver these critical applications and solutions supporting Scout's direct-to-consumer business.

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

Direct engineering efforts supporting the complete customer lifecycle, from brand discovery and vehicle purchase through delivery, ownership, service engagement, accessories, and long-term customer relationship management.
Direct engineering teams responsible for the mobile application that comprises customer commercial experiences along with vehicle companion controls and functions.
Define and execute engineering strategy, web front-end architecture, and technical roadmaps aligned with Digital Product Engineering and company objectives.
Partner with Growth, Marketing, Product, and Analytics teams to drive experimentation, A/B testing, personalization, and conversion optimization across customer acquisition and e-commerce funnels.
Partner with senior leaders across Product, Finance, Operations, Vehicle Engineering, IT, Legal, and external partners to align priorities, resolve complex cross-functional challenges, and drive business outcomes.
Build and develop engineering leaders, including Engineering Managers, Principal Engineers, and Staff Engineers, while establishing succession plans and organizational capabilities that scale with business growth.
Drive continuous improvement in Core Web Vitals, application responsiveness, reliability, and site availability to deliver best-in-class customer experiences.
Own operational planning, capacity management, vendor engagements, and delivery execution across the Customer Experience Engineering organization.
Hire, coach, and grow engineering leaders while building a strong engineering culture.
Influence AI-assisted software development and modern engineering practices to improve developer productivity and software quality.
Influence executive decision-making through clear communication of engineering strategy, platform investments, business tradeoffs, organizational and engineering health, delivery risk, and long-term technology direction.
Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer obsession.
Partner with Cybersecurity, Legal, Privacy, and Compliance teams to ensure customer-facing applications meet security, privacy, regulatory, and data governance requirements.
Lead the design and evolution of digital platforms capable of supporting future regional expansion, multiple markets, localized experiences, payment methods, and evolving regulatory requirements.
Own engineering standards and investment priorities for web performance, accessibility, SEO, resiliency, and overall digital experience quality across customer-facing web properties.
Define and monitor key performance indicators across digital commerce, customer engagement, application performance, reliability, conversion, retention, and customer satisfaction.
Champion a data-driven engineering culture leveraging behavioral analytics, customer insights, experimentation, application telemetry, and operational metrics to guide investment decisions and product improvements.
Drive investments in platform architecture, engineering excellence, automation, and self-service capabilities that enable rapid product innovation, operational efficiency, and business scalability.
Develop and execute the long-term engineering roadmap for customer-facing platforms, APIs, content management systems, experimentation frameworks, observability, and developer experience capabilities, while driving investments in platform architecture, automation, engineering excellence, and self-service tooling.
Partner closely with Vehicle Software Engineering and Platform teams to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable integrations between customer-facing mobile applications and vehicle systems.
Define the engineering vision for mobile applications as a core component of the vehicle ownership experience, enabling vehicle access, vehicle controls, notifications, charging management, service interactions, and connected customer experiences.
Lead platform capabilities supporting customer identity, authentication, account management, customer profiles, and seamless user experiences across web, mobile, and connected digital touchpoints.
Own engineering strategy and execution for digital commerce experiences including vehicle configuration, reservation flows, checkout, financing, trade-in, delivery scheduling, and post-purchase customer journeys.
Translate company growth objectives, customer experience goals, and business priorities into engineering investment strategies and execution plans.
Partner with platform and infrastructure teams to ensure highly available, resilient, and scalable customer-facing digital services.
Establish and monitor engineering health metrics including delivery predictability, platform reliability, developer productivity, quality, and operational excellence.
Own prioritization, sequencing, and execution planning across customer-facing web and mobile engineering portfolios to ensure alignment with company objectives and resource constraints.

Cancer is the number one cause of death for commercially insured Americans and the top cost driver for health plans. And, cancer patients are struggling.

This is not a role where you’ll inherit a mature engineering organization or a predefined roadmap. You’ll work closely with leaders across the business to understand how our service operates today, identify the highest-impact opportunities for technology, and determine what we should build, buy, automate, or redesign.

This is a highly entrepreneurial, hands-on leadership role. You’ll have significant autonomy to shape both what we build and how engineering operates at CancerNavigator. You will:

Partner with our CEO and functional leaders to set the technical strategy and roadmap for the business.
Identify the highest-impact opportunities to use technology and AI to help our team serve more patients at scale.
Design and build foundational systems, particularly in the early stages of the role.
Lead the development of tools across patient navigation, communication, research, and healthcare data processing.
Grow and lead our engineering function, establishing the team, infrastructure, and practices we’ll need for our next stage of growth.

Competitive salary and stock option package

We’re building a company where what we do matters. The goal couldn’t be clearer – serve cancer patients. As the business grows, and the work becomes more complex, we need to become more, not less, committed to why we are doing this.

jobs.title: Global Director, AI, Data, & Emerging Technology Advancement
jobs.description:
The Director, AI, Data, and Emerging Technology Advancement
is a new leadership role within the Global Business Systems (herein referred to as “GBS”) team and is responsible for building BAC (Baltimore Aircoil Company, Inc.)’s strategy, architecture, governance, and capability across two connected areas: the foundational data that the business runs on, and the AI, automation, and self-service analytics capabilities built on top of it. This person owns data strategy end to end — architecture, master data governance, tooling, and compliance — and uses that foundation to define how the business uses AI and Emerging Technology tools and self-service analytics safely and effectively.

This is a build role at the intersection of strategy and hands-on governance; accountable for getting the underlying data foundation right, then building the strategy, governance, and training that make safe, effective self-service AI and analytics possible on top of it.

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

Data Foundation

Data Strategy
: define the enterprise data strategy: what data matters most to the business, how it should be organized and governed, and how the strategy sequences over time as the company grows.
Data Architecture
: own the enterprise data architecture: how data flows between SAP, custom applications, the MarTech stack, and analytics platforms, in partnership with Enterprise Architecture.
Master Data Governance:
Stand up master data governance for the enterprise's critical data domains (e.g., customer, product, vendor, materials). Define parameters for ownership, stewardship, quality standards, and the processes that keep master data trustworthy as it moves through SAP and downstream systems.
Data Quality & Lifecycle:
drive the ongoing effort to identify and remediate legacy, unstructured, duplicate, and over-permissioned data across the enterprise, partnering with business data owners.
Data Tooling & Platform
: evaluate, select, and govern the enterprise's data platform and tooling to manage data quality, cataloging, master data management, and integration.
Data Compliance & Privacy
: own the data governance controls that keep the enterprise compliant with data privacy and retention obligations, including cross-border data handling where relevant to the company's global footprint; partner with legal and compliance on data policies and with security on enforcement.

AI, Automation, Emerging Technology & Self-Service

AI & Analytics Strategy
: define the enterprise roadmap for self-service AI and analytics, including standard toolsets and guardrails, built on top of the data foundation strategy and tools.
AI Governance
: own the governance framework for AI use across the enterprise: acceptable use, data access boundaries, oversight of AI-surfaced content, security, and risk review for new AI use cases. Evaluate and deploy the tools that control what AI can see and surface, including restricted content discovery, M365 archive, SharePoint advanced management, and DLP.
Automation
: set the strategy and standards for process automation (RPA, workflow automation, low-code tools), self-service governance, monitoring, and maintenance.
Self-Service Analytics
: own the platform, standards, and support model for self-service analytics.
Emerging Technology:
own the evaluation and recommendation of emerging technologies to drive operational efficiency, enhance business effectiveness, and support digital transformation objectives .

Enablement & Training
: build and deploy the training and change management program for self-service AI, automation, and analytics tools.
Risk & Compliance Partnership
: work with security, legal, and compliance to make sure AI, automation, and data use stay within regulatory and privacy obligations as the program scales.
Center of Excellence
: stand up a lightweight data & AI center of excellence with champions, standards, and a support model that scales with adoption.
Cross-Functional Partnership
: partner closely enterprise architecture, infrastructure, and security to allow the data, AI, and automation strategy to leverage and enhance existing platform investments.

NATURE AND SCOPE

The Global Director,
AI, Data, and Emerging Technology Advancement
reports to the Global Vice President, Chief Digital & Information Officer and is a member of the IT leadership team. As part of the Global Business Systems organization, this role influences senior leaders across the enterprise and partners closely with regional business teams.

The role leads a globally dispersed team of approximately 6 to 10 professionals, including internal employees and contracted resources, and is expected to expand as the organization grows.

The role is accountable for the AI, Data, and Automation strategy, architecture, governance, and capability and owns the associated multi-year roadmap, operating and capital budget, tools ecosystem, and associated vendor relationships.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THE FIRST YEAR

A documented enterprise data strategy and target-state data architecture, aligned with Enterprise Architecture.
Master data governance stood up for at least one or two critical domains, with clear ownership and stewardship in place.
A published AI governance framework and acceptable use policy deployed across the enterprise.
Measurable reduction in stale, unstructured, duplicate, and over-permissioned data reachable by AI tools like Copilot and others.
A self-service analytics platform and support model with real adoption, reducing the backlog of ad hoc reporting requests to IT.
A training program with completion and usage metrics tracked.
Several automation use cases delivered end-to-end, and plan to scale further.

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

10+ years in data, analytics, or AI-related roles in enterprise IT, with 4+ years in a leadership role owning data strategy and governance, delivery and reporting.
Direct experience building enterprise data strategy and architecture — able to make and defend decisions about how data should flow, be owned, and be governed across a multi-system landscape.
Hands-on master data management (MDM) experience, designing governance for critical data domains (customer, product, vendor, materials, or similar) and standing up business stewardship models.
Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot (and other popular AI tools), governance and the surrounding data governance toolset (e.g., Purview, SharePoint Advanced Management, Restricted Content Discovery, or equivalents).
Working knowledge of data privacy and compliance obligations relevant to a global manufacturer (e.g., GDPR and similar cross-border data regimes), and how to translate them into practical governance controls.
Practical experience building a governance framework from scratch, including policy, standards, and training, in an organization without a mature data or AI governance function already in place.
Experience with self-service BI/analytics platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau), data platf
orm/MDM tooling (e.g., Purview, Informatica, SAP Master Data Governance), and process automation tools (e.g., Power Automate, UiPath).
Experience with enterprise data platforms in an SAP environment is a plus.
Manufacturing, industrial, or engineer-to-order environment experience is a plus.
Comfortable operating as a builder in an evolving organization; someone who scales governance and tooling appropriate to the pace of the team adoption.
A direct, clear communication style, able to explain data and AI risk and governance to executives and end users in practical terms.

If your experience aligns with the core of this role—building and growing teams that engineer risk out of existence—and you can show us how, we want to hear from you!

Engineering Management: Experience (7+ years) managing engineers, within a broader career (14+ years) across software engineering, SRE, infrastructure, or security. You have grown people, not only shipped projects.

Delivery Under Ambiguity: You can take a high-stakes, loosely defined mandate and turn it into sequenced, measurable delivery. You are comfortable proving a model on a few systems first, then using that success to expand.
Cloud-Native and Security Fluency: Working understanding of cloud-native architecture, container orchestration (Kubernetes), identity and access, policy enforcement, and vulnerability management—enough to build it and ask the questions that matter.
Influence Without Authority: Experience delivering through partner teams you do not own, in environments where relationships, not org charts, determine whether the work ships.
Foundation: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

HPC/AI Infrastructure: Experience running teams that secure or operate high-performance computing environments, large GPU fleets, or multi-tenant platforms at cloud scale.

Scaling Without Dilution: A history of growing a team quickly while the bar went up rather than down. How have you scaled a team and raised the standard at the same time?

Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, PlentyOfFish, OkCupid, The League, HER, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire.

When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL). We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days/week.

Across Match Group, we have an opportunity to build shared capabilities that help our brands make better decisions, move faster, and scale what works across the portfolio.

The Senior Director, Growth Technology & Platforms
will lead the team responsible for MarTech Engineering, Marketing Data Foundations, Technical Program Management, and Organic Growth.

You’ll bring these disciplines together as one cohesive organization, developing technical leaders and functional experts while building shared capabilities used across a global portfolio of consumer products. If you’re the kind of person who believes that honoring and empowering our nation’s veterans is more than just a cause — that it’s a calling — then we’re ready to meet you.

When you join Wounded Warrior Project® (WWP), you’re committing to making a difference. We make a commitment to you, too – helping you to find that spark, ignite your passion to serve, and embark on a career with meaning and purpose.

At WWP™, we recognize our mission cannot be accomplished without our talented teammates, which is why we’re proud to offer benefits such as:

A fun, mission-focused, and collaborative team environment

This role fosters alignment across cybersecurity, infrastructure, and architecture; develops senior technology leaders; and partners with IT governance, executive leadership, and business stakeholders to guide technology investments, manage risk, and uphold enterprise standards. Serving as a key advisor to the CIO, the Vice President promotes collaboration, innovation, accountability, and operational excellence across the technology organization.

Provide executive leadership, vision, and strategic direction across the Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, and Enterprise Architecture functions, ensuring alignment and coordination across teams to drive integrated technology outcomes.

Remove organizational barriers, resolve competing priorities, and serve as the executive escalation point for strategic decisions, operational needs, and cross-functional technology challenges.
Establish a clear and unified vision and roadmap that balances security, infrastructure and architectural objectives.

Guide infrastructure and platform modernization efforts that improve scalability, reliability, automation, and service quality.
Partner with the IT governance team to ensure effective prioritization and execution across teams with a focus on reducing risk, supporting control maturity, and improving organizational technology effectiveness.
Support leadership in the effective integration of the governance team’s requirements, risk priorities, audit findings, and technical remediation activities into the team’s planning and execution, aligning decisions across Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, and Enterprise Architecture with enterprise governance frameworks and strategic objectives.

Other related duties as assigned.

Deep understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and of security and enterprise architecture principles that promote consistency, interoperability, resiliency, and sustainability.
Advanced knowledge of cloud transformation, infrastructure modernization, cybersecurity maturity, automation, resilience engineering, enterprise architecture, and emerging technologies that improve scalability, reliability, service quality, and operational efficiency.

Experience establishing strategic priorities, performance measures, and accountability frameworks across complex technology organizations and using operational, risk, resilience, service, and financial metrics to strengthen decision-making and continuous improvement.

High degree of accountability, sound judgment, integrity, and commitment to professional ethics, WWP core values, technology innovation, service excellence, and continuous improvement.

Banc of California, Inc. (NYSE: BANC) is a bank holding company with over $34 billion in assets and the parent company of Banc of California. The bank also provides full-service payment processing solutions to its clients and serves the Community Association Management industry nationwide through its technology forward platform, SmartStreet™. Banc of California is committed to supporting its local communities through the Banc of California Charitable Foundation and by partnering with organizations that promote financial literacy, job training, small business support, affordable housing, and more.

At Banc of California, our success is powered by our people and a shared commitment to delivering meaningful results. We foster an environment where entrepreneurial thinking is encouraged, and accountability and operational excellence are expected. Our team members are empowered to take ownership, make informed decisions, and make a meaningful impact as the bank continues to grow and evolve. We are dedicated to supporting your growth and wellbeing through comprehensive benefits, robust development opportunities, and inclusive programs that enable you to perform at your best. Together we win!

THE OPPORTUNITY

The VP, Analytics Engineering will lead the design and delivery of enterprise data products on the bank’s Data Foundation Platform. Reporting to the VP, Data Engineering & Delivery Manager, this hands-on, player-coach leadership role oversees a small team and works alongside engineers while partnering across the broader data organization and the business. This position combines deep hands-on expertise in Snowflake, dbt, and SQL with the ability to set standards, deliver quality data products, and develop talent in a SOX-controlled environment.

Performs all duties in accordance with the Company’s policies and procedures, all U.S. state and federal laws and regulations, wherein the Company operates.

How You’ll Make a Difference

Lead and work alongside a small team of Analytics Engineers, Data Architects, and Modelers; hire, coach, and develop talent.
Design, build, and deliver scalable data solutions hands-on using Snowflake, dbt, SQL, and Microsoft Azure.
Establish engineering standards for dbt, SQL, data modeling, documentation, version control, testing, and deployment.
Guide reusable dbt models, macros, and semantic models, and lead dimensional data modeling, including Star Schemas and Fact and Dimension tables.
Own the transformation and modeling layers of the platform.
Build quality into development through dbt tests, data contracts, documentation, and peer review, partnering with the Quality Engineering team, which owns enterprise test frameworks and release certification.
Champion agentic engineering across the team by applying AI coding agents and AI-assisted development tools to accelerate dbt model development, code generation, refactoring, and documentation, with governed human review.
Evaluate and adopt emerging agentic development patterns and tooling for the Analytics Engineering workflow, setting standards for the safe, auditable use of AI in a SOX-controlled environment, and partner with Quality Engineering, which owns the Agentic Test Harness.
Embed dbt tests and quality gates into Git-based CI/CD pipelines as part of standard development practice and support root-cause analysis of production data defects.
Optimize Snowflake performance and cost across query tuning, warehouse utilization, and transformation design.
Manage priorities, capacity, and delivery commitments, and partner with Product, BI, Governance, Operations & Quality, and the business.
Participate in interviewing and hiring decisions.
Prepare and deliver employee performance evaluations, goal planning, and counseling.
Manage, support, coach, and train employees.
Follow all established policies and procedures.
Perform other duties and projects as assigned.

What You’ll Bring

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
8+ years of progressive experience in Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, Data Warehouse Development, or related roles.
3+ years of experience leading technical teams, managing engineering delivery, and developing employees.
4+ years of deep hands-on experience delivering enterprise data solutions using Snowflake, dbt, SQL, and Microsoft Azure.
3+ years of advanced experience with production-grade dbt projects, including modular models, macros, testing, documentation, lineage, freshness, snapshots, and incremental processing.
5+ years of experience in dimensional and relational modeling, data warehousing, Medallion Architecture, semantic models, and modern ELT.
Advanced SQL development, debugging, performance tuning, and query optimization skills.
Experience building well-tested, reliable data pipelines using dbt tests, data contracts, and data-quality checks as part of standard development practice.
Working knowledge of batch and CDC ingestion patterns using Azure Data Factory or equivalent technologies.
Experience with Python or another modern language for data processing, automation, APIs, and scripting.
Working knowledge of Azure Data Factory, ADLS Gen2, and Azure Synapse Analytics.
Experience with Git, Azure DevOps or comparable tools, CI/CD, pull requests, and automated quality gates.
Strong understanding of data governance, metadata, lineage, privacy, security, auditability, and regulatory controls.
Experience delivering data solutions in a SOX-controlled environment, including change management, control evidence, and audit support.
Ability to balance hands-on leadership, people management, delivery oversight, and strategic planning in a fast-paced environment.
Experience leading Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or Data Architecture in a regulated organization.
Banking or financial services experience, including loans, deposits, treasury products, customers, accounts, or regulatory reporting.
Experience applying agentic AI and AI-assisted development tools to accelerate engineering delivery, including establishing standards for governed, auditable use of AI in development workflows.
Experience with data-quality or observability tools such as dbt tests, Great Expectations, Soda, Monte Carlo, or comparable platforms.
Relevant Snowflake, dbt, Microsoft Azure, or comparable cloud data certifications.
High school diploma or equivalent required.

How We’ll Support You

Financial Security: You will be eligible to participate in the company’s 401k plan which includes a company match and immediate vesting.
Health & Well-Being: We offer comprehensive insurance options including medical, dental, vision, AD&D, supplemental life, long-term disability, pre-tax Health Savings Account with employer contributions, and pre-tax Flexible Spending Account (FSA).
Building & Supporting Your Family: Banc of California partners with providers that offer adoption, surrogacy, and fertility assistance as well as paid parental leave and family support solutions including care options for your family.
Paid Time Away: Eligible team members receive paid vacation days, holidays, and volunteer time off.
Career Growth Opportunities: To support career growth of our team members, we offer tuition reimbursement, an annual mentorship program, leadership development resources, access to LinkedIn Learning, and more.

The base salary ultimately offered is determined through a review of education, industry experience, training, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant in alignment with market data and other factors.
